people.imagined: Afternoon in the jacket shed. She has pulled off her mittens to show a new apprentice the right way to lift a copper jacket and is mid-argument with someone off frame about the Water roots at the furnace door. Her hands are the only thing she is proud of.
people.subject: The moment: in a steamy packing shed in the afternoon she has just pulled off her mittens and holds both bare hands up at chest height, palms toward the viewer, as if to say look at these. Face: most important, the hands: both hands and wrists are scarred a glossy pink in long burn stripes from hot copper, the scars clearly visible and large in the frame. A square, determined face of about thirty-six with a strong chin, skin tanned ruddy from the steam, thick straight brows drawn down in a scowl, hazel eyes bright and combative, a short broad nose, a wide mouth set in a stubborn line, a small dent between the brows. Hair: dark brown, thick, twisted into one heavy knot at the nape and held by a bronze pin shaped like a flame, loose strands damp at her temples. Body: stocky, broad-shouldered, leaning slightly forward. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of rust and brick-red silk with crossed collars lined in soft grey seal fur, an ember-red gauze over-robe with wide sleeves pushed above the elbow so that the scarred forearms show, collars embroidered with small furnace flames and snowflakes in thread, a thick sealskin vest left open, two pairs of grey mittens stuffed into her sash so their fingers hang out. Hands and objects: the scarred bare hands; behind them the edge of a bright copper jacket beaded with water. Power: a shimmer of red heat rises from her bare palms with faint blue steam curling through it. Background: a blurred shed of racks hung with quilted copper jackets and white steam. Light: warm orange glow from a furnace low on the right, cool white daylight from the upper left on her face. Expression: scowling and argumentative, ready to talk over anyone.

people.imagined: Dusk at the quay of the fire-jade boat. He has not spoken in an hour, and the cold pipe is in his mouth because he has run out of the leaf to light it. He is watching the crew row out and decides again not to be the first Water root through the furnace door.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a wooden quay he watches the viewer sidelong with an unlit pipe clamped in his teeth, completely unbothered. Face: most important, the pipe and the creased neck: a short blackened wooden pipe with a bone stem tilted upward at the left of his mouth, and the neck above the collar deeply creased in a criss-cross of lines. A long, lean, sun-creased face of about forty-four the colour of old rope, narrow grey-green eyes half-lidded with crow's feet fanning to the temples, a hooked nose, salt-and-pepper stubble along the jaw, fine salt crystals dried in the hollows of his cheeks. Hair: dark and thinning, cropped short, a faded blue cloth band tied around the forehead. Body: lanky, loose-limbed, one shoulder dropped, leaning on something out of frame. Clothing: a rust-brown silk robe with an open crossed collar and a brick-red gauze over-robe, grey seal fur at the collar and cuffs, embroidered at the hem with small flames and snowflakes, an oiled dark seal-skin jacket over it as a boatman's cloak, a loop of rope over one shoulder; the forearms bare and rope-scarred. Hands and objects: one hand lifted to take the pipe out, the knuckles thick and scarred by rope, a coil of wet rope in the other. Power: a faint blue-green breath of water qi gathers in the damp air round the rope. Background: a blurred grey sea, a boat with a dark tarred sail low behind his shoulder, a gold ember-jade glow in the hull, lanterns along the quay throwing soft amber discs on the water. Light: low amber dusk from the upper left, a cold blue sky behind. Expression: a sleepy, amused, deliberately lazy look, the pipe tilted in a grin.

people.imagined: Night at the furnace mouth. She is stirring the broth pot with a ladle too big for her and has just stuffed a letter into the fire without reading it. The flames make her laugh.
people.subject: The moment: at night beside a glowing furnace mouth she is mid-laugh, one hand tossing a folded paper into the flames, the other holding a long ladle upright. Face: a round, open, freckled face of twenty with full cheeks pink from the heat, big dark brown eyes crinkled with laughter, a snub nose with a smear of soot on its tip, a wide mouth showing a small gap between her front teeth. Hair: black, in one lopsided thick braid over her left shoulder tied at the end with a loop of kitchen twine, short wisps frizzing at her forehead. Body: sturdy and short, shoulders relaxed. Clothing: the simple, clean silk of the lowest rank of the valley: a plain rust-brown tunic with a crossed collar and narrow sleeves rolled to the elbow, a brick-red sash, grey seal fur only at the collar, a large cream linen apron over it splashed down the front with brown broth, strings tied in a bow at the neck, a cord of twine round her wrist; no embroidery. Hands and objects: a big iron ladle held upright with steam rising from it, and a small folded blank paper at the edge of the fire. Power: a few small red-gold sparks leap from the burning paper to her sleeve and glow there, as if the flames laughed with her. Background: a blurred iron pot the size of a barrel, an orange furnace mouth, hanging copper pans. Light: strong orange firelight from the lower right, a dim cool night behind and a soft ember rim along her braid. Expression: laughing, careless and a little defiant.

people.imagined: Furnace roster room, late. He holds a brush and a page he has copied perfectly, and looks up with a slow smile at a boy who has come in to ask a favour. He enjoys being looked at as a person who decides things.
people.subject: The moment: in a lamplit writing room late at night he looks up from his work with a smile held a little too long, brush in hand. Face: most important, the smile and the burn: a narrow, handsome face with high cheekbones and a straight nose; a thick pale burn-line runs across the chin from the left jaw to the right, shiny and raised and clearly visible; thin dark eyebrows arched; heavy-lidded black eyes that do not blink; his thin mouth stretched into a smile that stays after it should have ended. He looks about twenty-seven. Hair: black, glossy, tied high in a tight topknot with a strip of cinnabar-red silk under a small bronze hairpin. Body: slim, upright, narrow shoulders squared. Clothing: an inner disciple's carefully pressed robe of rust and brick-red silk with a high crossed collar lined in grey seal fur, an ember-red gauze over-robe, embroidered with fine furnace flames and snowflakes, sleeves pushed back above the wrists to show the forearms, a thin black cuff band on each sleeve. Hands and objects: his right hand holds a thin brush, the right thumb stained bright cinnabar red to the first joint; his left hand rests flat on a pale blank sheet of paper on a low desk. Power: a faint red-orange glow breathes in the lamp flame and a few red sparks drift above the brush. Background: a dim wall of pigeonholes and one oil lamp. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left, deep shadow on the right of his face. Expression: smiling, patient, cold.

people.imagined: Midday on the fire-jade boat, ballast being shifted. She has just pocketed a chip of gold fire jade and is checking whether anyone saw, with a bright, innocent face.
people.subject: The moment: on the deck of a boat in strong sun she glances to one side with an innocent, bright face while one hand is tucked casually at her collar. Face: a broad, tanned, freckled face of nineteen with strong cheekbones, wide-set dark eyes quick and watchful, thick black brows, a small nose peeling from sunburn, full lips pressed together in a bright, too-sweet smile. Hair: black, chopped short with a knife just above the ears, spiky and salt-stiff, a thin braid at the nape. Body: powerful for her size, broad shoulders, thick forearms bare from the rolled sleeves. Clothing: an outer disciple's rust-brown silk shirt with short sleeves and a brick-red sash, a short oiled seal-skin vest over it, grey seal fur at the collar, a leather strap across the chest; at the left collar a chip of gold-yellow ember-jade sewn into the silk with red thread, glinting. Hands and objects: her right hand holds the end of a wooden oar planted like a staff, the left holds a rope. Power: the chip of jade holds a small warm gold glimmer, and a faint blue breath of water qi lies in the spray at her sleeve. Background: a blurred blue sea and a hull edge of grey planks, a faint gold glow in the bilge. Light: bright white sun from the upper left, sparkle on the water behind. Expression: innocent and eager, with a flicker of cunning in the eyes.

people.imagined: Snow house, after midnight. He is rolling one die between his fingers while he owes everyone, and does not realise he is doing it. A man across the table has just said his name.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim snow house after midnight he turns his head toward someone off frame at the sound of his name, a small bone die rolling between the fingers of one hand. Face: a thin, quick, boyish face of twenty-five with a wide jaw, skin windburned to two red flushes high on the cheeks, large restless brown eyes with dark circles under them, a crooked easy grin, a short light-brown stubble, one ear sticking out. Hair: sandy brown, long on top and unkempt, a battered flat felt hat pulled down over his left ear and tilted, grime darkening the roots. Body: wiry, slouched, one shoulder forward. Clothing: a boatman's rust-brown silk robe with the collar askew and brick-red edging, grey seal fur at the cuffs, a dark oiled seal-skin coat unbuttoned over it, a loose scarf of red wool round the neck, one cuff unbuttoned; the silk is the simplest of the sect's, with no embroidery. Hands and objects: the fingers of his right hand roll a small bone die across the knuckles; his left hand rests on a wooden table scattered with a few small pebbles and a dented tin cup. Power: a faint blue water qi shimmers in the cup like a held breath. Background: a low snow-block wall, one hanging lamp, other gamblers as dark blurred shapes, a thin trail of breath-steam at the low door. Light: warm yellow lamplight from the upper left, cold blue at the edge. Expression: an easy, charming grin with a little hunted tension behind it, the eyes flicking toward whoever said his name.

people.imagined: Brewing room at dawn. She hums while she stirs a small pot and tucks a strand of hair behind her ear without seeing the soot she leaves. She is worried about the quarrel but the tune does not know it.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn in a brewing room she looks down into a small pot she stirs, humming, her head slightly bowed so the birthmark shows. Face: most important, the birthmark: a small coal-coloured mark, dark grey-black and the size of a thumbnail, clearly visible on the left side of her neck above the collar. A small, gentle, heart-shaped face of about twenty-two with pale freckled skin, soft brown eyes lowered, thin straight brows slightly lifted in worry, a small mouth curved in a faint hum, one smudge of soot on the cheek. Hair: light chestnut brown, pinned up in a neat round coil with two small bronze pins, short wisps escaping at the neck. Body: slight, shoulders narrow, elbows tucked in. Clothing: an inner disciple's plain, neatly pressed robe of rust and brick-red silk with a crossed collar lined in grey seal fur, a pale ember-red gauze over-robe, sleeves tied back with cloth cords, a small grey linen apron, around her neck a thin cord with a small spoon-shaped wooden charm; the embroidery at her collar is a single row of tiny flames. Hands and objects: a long wooden paddle in her right hand dipping into a small copper pot; her left hand cups a clay cup. Power: a faint warm red glow rises with the steam, and a few red-gold sparks float over the pot. Background: shelves of small clay jars, a window with the first pink light. Light: soft pink dawn light from the upper left, warm glow from the pot below. Expression: absorbed and soft, with a worry underneath that her humming does not know.

people.imagined: The council hall at night, the one hour he is alone. He warms his hands on the censer and thinks of the year he gave nine years of snow to the fire. He speaks to the coal as to an old friend.
people.subject: The moment: seated alone at night in the council hall, he holds both palms out over a small bronze censer on his knee as if warming them, and looks at the viewer over it. Face: most important, the glazed skin and the bare brow: a broad, round, short-necked old face of about seventy-two whose skin looks glazed and shiny like old burned clay, pink-brown and smooth in places; no eyebrows at all, only smooth skin above the eyes; deep-set small dark eyes with the red of coals in them; heavy cheeks, a wide flat nose, a wide thin mouth in a slow small smile, deep lines at the mouth. Hair: a thin ring of white hair above the ears, the crown bald and ruddy under a small bronze crown. Body: short, broad and thick through the chest, rounded shoulders, heavy square hands. Clothing: as head of his house he wears the richest dress of the valley: a white seal-fur mantle over layered crimson brocade, a deep ember-red gauze over-robe, the collar edged with a thick band of white seal fur and embroidered with furnace flames and snowflakes in gold thread, a black iron ring on his left ring finger. Hands and objects: a bronze censer the size of two fists on his lap with a coal glowing at its mouth; his hands, glazed like his face, held over it. Power: a deep red-orange heat shimmers about his shoulders and a few green wood-motes rise with the sparks from the coal, the glow of a long-burning furnace in a man. Background: a dark hall with a faint red wall of furnace-light beyond, carved benches and a tall brass lamp-stand. Light: red-orange from the coal rising on to his chin, cool grey from the upper left. Expression: a warm, slyly amused look with the small slow smile, an old man speaking fondly to a coal.

people.imagined: A winter morning in the jacket hall; she has just lifted the first snow jacket from its stand and checked its weight against her wrist. She never raises her voice, and now she is quietly listening to someone shout.
people.subject: The moment: in the jacket hall on a winter morning she stands very tall and still, one hand lifting a quilted silk jacket from its stand, her head tilted as she listens to someone shouting. Face: a long, serene, pale face of about forty-eight with high cheekbones and a long straight nose; frost-white rime on the lashes and the hem of her sleeves; calm grey eyes, steady; thin brows; thin closed lips; a faint soot smudge on the right cheekbone; fine lines at the eye corners. Hair: black streaked with one broad white streak from the left temple, gathered into a low knot at the nape under a slim bronze crown with a narrow copper pin. Body: tall, straight-backed, long neck, wide shoulders. Clothing: as first elder of the valley she wears its rich dress: a white seal-fur mantle over crimson and rust brocade, a long ember-red gauze over-robe with wide sleeves lightly frosted at the cuffs, a collar of grey fur embroidered with furnace flames and snowflakes in silver and gold, below it the pale edge of a white inner robe. Hands and objects: her soot-blackened right hand lifts the First Snow Jacket, a quilted silk jacket in pale grey-blue with water faintly moving between its layers; in her other hand a black calabash gourd banded in copper, small as a pear. Power: a balance of faint red heat and pale blue chill hangs round her shoulders, red sparks and fine frost motes turning slowly around each other. Background: a row of identical quilted jackets on wooden stands in white steam. Light: cold white window light from the upper left, a warm orange line from a furnace at the far right. Expression: composed and listening, unhurried.

people.imagined: Training yard at noon. He has dyed a new robe the night before and is wearing it before the old men, wanting them all to see. He stands with his forearms bare and the scorch marks proud.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a bare winter yard at noon, arms crossed and chin up, he wants to be seen in a new robe he dyed the night before. Face: most important, the robe: a robe of vivid cinnabar red silk, far brighter and redder than anyone else's rust-brown, fills the lower frame. A lean, sharp young face of twenty-eight with high cheekbones, a pointed chin, narrow black eyes under straight sharp brows, a thin hawkish nose, a faint smirk on thin lips, a clean-shaved jaw. Hair: black, combed back smooth and tied high in a tight topknot with a lacquer-red band and a small bronze crown; a single lock hangs loose at the left. Body: lean, wiry, broad at the shoulder; forearms bare and scarred with many small dark burn-marks, worn openly. Clothing: as the head's true disciple he wears the rich version: the hand-dyed cinnabar robe with a crossed stiff collar lined in white seal fur, a crimson brocade over-robe with sleeves pushed to the elbow, flame and snowflake embroidery in gold thread, a black belt of braided leather, a black silk shirt beneath. Hands and objects: arms crossed; on the right forearm a small shallow iron dish of glowing coals held balanced. Power: a strong hot red shimmer of fire qi rises above his shoulders in a crown of wavering sparks, bright as his robe. Background: a blurred snowy yard, grey-clad men in two rows, a pale sky. Light: flat bright winter light from the upper left, sharp shadows, a red glow along his arms. Expression: chin high and eyes bright, a young man wanting the old ones to look at him.

people.imagined: An herb shed at dusk. She is counting the satchels on their pegs by touch and finds one missing; her mouth goes tight. The green of the satchel is the only green she has.
people.subject: The moment: in an herb shed at dusk she stands with her hand flat on a green satchel across her chest, as though holding it shut, her head tilted; she has found one satchel missing from the pegs. Face: most important, the green satchel: a bright forest-green satchel with a brass buckle, as wide as her torso, crossing her chest from the right shoulder to the left hip, the one green thing in the picture. A small, round, grey, wrinkled woman's face of about sixty, round cheeks, a small nose, faded blue-grey eyes sharp as a hawk's, thin grey brows, thin lips pressed shut, a faint downturn at the corners of her mouth. Hair: grey and fine, parted in the middle and pinned in a tight bun with a bone pin. Body: very small and slightly stooped, but firm. Clothing: as warden of a hall she dresses with quiet richness: a high-collared robe of rust and brick-red silk lined in soft grey seal fur, an ember-red gauze over-robe, a grey silk shawl over the shoulders, collars embroidered with small flames and snowflakes, narrow sleeves with neat cuffs, small black boots out of frame. Hands and objects: a hard hand on the satchel flap; in the other a small bundle of dry mugwort tied with red thread. Power: a faint green breath of wood qi rises from the herb bundle and drifts round her fingers in slow motes. Background: wooden pegs with other, empty hooks, hanging bundles of dried herbs, the dusk window. Light: dim blue dusk from the upper left, a thin warm lamp glow below. Expression: severe and watchful, grieving under it.

people.imagined: The quay at dawn after a night at sea. He is looking at the horizon past the reef where his great-grandfather's boat lies, and the harpoon on his back is heavier than usual. Someone has asked a question and he does not hear it.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on a stone quay he is a huge figure looking out to sea, his back half-turned, the harpoon showing over his shoulder, not hearing a question someone has asked. Face: most important, the beard: a thick, tangled brown-grey beard that reaches the chest, white with salt crystals. A huge, weathered face of about fifty-two as wide as a shield, heavy brow ridges, small deep-set grey eyes narrowed against the glare, a thick nose broken once, deep wind lines at the eyes. Hair: brown and grey, long and thick, tied back in a short tail with leather under a plain bronze circlet. Body: enormous: wide neck, shoulders as broad as a door, thick arms. Clothing: a captain's dress: a robe of rust and crimson silk lined in grey seal fur, an ember-red gauze over-robe, a hooded oiled seal-skin coat in glossy black-brown over it with the hood down and the collar stiff with salt, flame and snowflake embroidery at the hem, leather straps across the chest. Hands and objects: across his back a harpoon of pale spirit-whale rib with an iron head and a coil of sea-silk line, the head rising behind his right shoulder; one hand rests on the shaft. Power: a deep blue-green sea qi rolls round his boots and the shaft like a low tide of mist, and a few fine pale motes of spray rise around him. Background: a grey-pink dawn, a blurred reef, a dark wreck-shape in the surf. Light: low pink-gold from the upper left on the left of his beard, the rest in cold shadow. Expression: brooding and far away, the jaw set.

people.imagined: Night watch at the red furnace. He is sitting by the vent with a pouch in his lap, counting jade pieces with a thumb, and has not hurried in a hundred years. A sound makes him look up slowly.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a stool by a vent in the night, his thumb moving over a small pouch in his lap, he lifts his eyes slowly toward a sound. Face: most important, the singed queue: a long grey queue of hair over his shoulder, burned short and uneven at the end so that it looks singed like a fuse, the tip darker and curling where the fire took it. A long, thin, hollow-cheeked old face of about seventy, tallow-yellow skin, heavy eyelids, small pale eyes, a long nose, thin colourless lips, a grey sparse moustache, deep creases down from the nose. Hair: grey, scraped back tight from the forehead into the queue, the temples bald. Body: tall, thin and slightly bent, very still. Clothing: as a warden of the valley he dresses in old, rich and spotless things: a heavy robe of rust and brick-red silk lined in grey seal fur, a deep ember-red gauze over-robe, collars embroidered with fine furnace flames and snowflakes, a wide black belt, a dark silk cloak over the shoulders clasped with a plain brass pin. Hands and objects: a small leather pouch in his lap, one thumb pressing a pea-sized gold-yellow stone half out of it; a lantern with a red glass beside his knee. Power: a faint red-orange heat shimmers over the gold stone and the blue-black air about him, patient as a banked coal. Background: dark, a furnace vent glowing behind a stone arch, a heavy wooden door. Light: red-orange glow from the vent on the lower left of his face, cold blue moonlight from the upper left. Expression: an unhurried stillness, the pale eyes rising slowly from the pouch.

people.imagined: Kitchen morning, dumplings by the hundred. He holds a letter, once, and it is the only thing he ever re-reads. He hides it in the flour bin and laughs at the face he has made.
people.subject: The moment: in a kitchen on a morning of dumplings by the hundred he pats a dumpling and laughs, flour in the air, one floury hand tucking a folded paper under his apron bib. Face: a round, lumpy, uneven face of about fifty-eight like a poorly pinched dumpling: cheeks sagging in folds, a double chin, a soft potato nose with a dent in the side, small cheerful black eyes buried in creases, thick white flour dusted across the eyebrows so they look like snow, a big toothy grin. Hair: thin black hair going grey, a small knot on top tied with a cloth strip, dusted with flour, a fleck of dough on one eyebrow. Body: very stout, round shoulders, a big belly. Clothing: the plain, clean silk of a cook of the valley, the simplest rank: a rust-brown silk tunic with a crossed collar edged in grey seal fur, sleeves rolled to the elbows over thick forearms, a huge cream apron smeared with flour and bean paste, a flat cloth cap hanging off the back of his head; one small flame stitched at the collar is all his embroidery. Hands and objects: a floury right hand pressing the top of a pale round dumpling; a wooden rolling-pin tucked under his left arm; a corner of folded paper, soft and pale and dusted with flour, visible at his bib. Power: a faint warm red glow lives in the stove coals, and a soft red-gold shimmer lies on the steam. Background: a steaming bamboo stack, a wall of copper pots, a stove with orange coals. Light: warm yellow light from a window at the upper left, steam glowing. Expression: a jolly, toothy grin with creased cheeks and a hidden ache behind the eyes.

people.imagined: The second ash boat in a fresh wind. She has rowed past the point where her father begged her to turn, and a spray of salt has bleached her fringe white. She does not look back.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the stern of a boat in a fresh wind she looks straight ahead and ignores a voice from behind, a hand held up to shield her eyes. Face: a long, narrow, tanned face of twenty-four with a strong jaw, hard dark-brown eyes with a cold steadiness, straight black brows, a high-bridged nose, a mouth set in a hard line, a faint scar at the corner of the lip; salt has dried in white lines at her temples and her lips are cracked. Hair: black bleached nearly white by salt at the tips, hacked short with a knife at jaw level in uneven lengths, blown sideways by the wind. Body: lean and strong, shoulders wide, standing very straight. Clothing: an outer disciple's boatwoman dress: a short-sleeved robe of rust and brick-red silk with grey seal fur at the collar, an oiled sleeveless seal-skin jacket over it, embroidery of small flames and snowflakes along the hem, a thick leather cuff on the left wrist, a belt of knotted sea-silk; the forearms bare. Hands and objects: her right palm, calloused and scarred from harpoon shafts, lifted open in front of her brow; her left hand grips an oar. Power: a blue-white sheen of water qi runs in the spray at her knuckles and sparkles on the oar. Background: a white-capped grey sea, a second oar and prow, a smudge of dark headland at the horizon, one gull wheeling high. Light: sharp white sea light from the upper left, cold, a silver rim along her cheek and white-bleached hair. Expression: a cold, intent, ambitious stare straight ahead, deaf to every voice behind her.

people.imagined: Snow-shovel yard at dusk. His face is black to the eyes with soot-snow; he answers a moment late and does not mind. He believes the fire will grow if he stands close.
people.subject: The moment: in a snowy yard at dusk he stands holding a shovel and looks at the viewer with a smile a moment slow to arrive. Face: most important, the black face: a wide, willing young face of sixteen blackened from the forehead to the lower lip with soot and snow-water in a thick grey-black mask, with a clean pink band around the mouth and chin; large round brown eyes very white in the black; short unplucked brows, a short wide nose, a gap-toothed grin. Hair: black, a shock of straight stiff hair sticking out under a grey knit cap pulled down to the brows, the tips blackened by soot. Body: gangly, thin shoulders, long arms, a little hunched. Clothing: the plainest rank's clean silk, one size too big: a rust-brown tunic with the sleeves rolled twice, a brick-red cord sash, grey seal fur at the collar, a short seal-skin vest over it, the cuffs black with soot; no embroidery yet. Hands and objects: both hands hold a long wooden shovel upright, its blade packed with snow, in thick fisherman's mittens, one with a hole at the thumb. Power: a very faint red heat shimmer hangs near his hands, as if the furnace were learning his name. Background: a snow bank, a copper jacket rack, steam, the dusk sky, piles of grey ash beside a low red-lit furnace door. Light: cold blue evening light from the upper left, orange from the furnace low right. Expression: a trusting, eager, slightly slow smile arriving a moment late over the black mask.

people.imagined: The brewing hall just after a batch is done. She stands with the cooling paddle like a staff, and her sleeves are spotless because she has been careful all day. Someone is being blamed in the next room and she says nothing.
people.subject: The moment: in the brewing hall just after a batch is done she stands straight with a tall cooling paddle held upright beside her like a staff, looking mildly at the viewer while someone is being blamed in the next room. Face: an oval, composed, pale-rose face of about thirty-one with smooth skin, level hazel eyes, thin neat arched brows, a small straight nose, closed lips with the faintest curl, a mole under the left eye. Hair: black with a faint auburn gloss, parted centrally and coiled into a smooth bun low at the nape, two plain silver pins. Body: slender, very upright, shoulders square, her weight even on both feet. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of rust and brick-red silk, perfectly pressed, with a crossed collar lined in grey seal fur and a fine white inner collar, an ember-red gauze over-robe with wide sleeves and crisp white cuffs without a speck of soot, flame and snowflake embroidery in thin silver thread, a dove-grey sash. Hands and objects: a long cooling paddle of pale wood taller than her head, its flat end resting on the floor, in her left hand; in the right a small white porcelain dish of a pale amber pill. Power: a gentle balance of faint red warmth and pale blue chill drifts up from the dish in the steam, the two colours turning together. Background: a bright clean brewing hall with rows of covered pots in soft steam, cooling trays of tidy amber pills, the shadow of a ladle on the wall. Light: even soft white light from the upper left, a thin warm glow from the trays. Expression: a serene, closed pleasantness with the faintest curl at the lips, a woman who says nothing while someone else is blamed.

people.imagined: A hillside in the cape forest at first light. He has found a rare plant, glances left and right and tucks it in his tin before anyone can see. Pollen is in his hair.
people.subject: The moment: crouched in a forest clearing at first light he looks sideways over his shoulder, hand closing a small tin lid on a rare plant he has just found. Face: most important, the pollen in his hair: bright yellow pollen dusts his dark hair and shoulders in a visible golden cloud, with a fleck on one eyelash. A narrow, wary, pale face of about thirty-three, a long nose, light hazel eyes darting to one side, thin brows, thin lips pressed together, patchy stubble on the chin. Hair: dark brown, floppy, falling in front of one eye, the pollen caught in it. Body: lean, hunched, crouching, knees up. Clothing: an outer disciple's robe of rust and brick-red silk with grey seal fur at the collar and cuffs, the hem tucked into the belt and stained green at the knees, a pale ember-red gauze over-robe with leaf fragments clinging to the sleeves, a green leather satchel across the chest with a brass buckle, smaller than his teacher's, a grey wool scarf. Hands and objects: in his right hand a small flat tin with a lid half closed over some pale-green leaves, its corner dented; in his left a short curved gathering knife; his thumb stained green from the stems. Power: a faint green breath of wood qi rises from the pale leaves and a few golden pollen motes glow as they drift up. Background: blurred ferns and pine trunks, a thin golden mist. Light: soft gold dawn light from the upper left through branches. Expression: a secretive, watchful, covetous look, the eyes slid sideways and the lips pressed.

people.imagined: The night in 929 when she knew the island coal was dying. A memorial portrait: the founder with her coal-box held to her hip, brows singed, looking toward the vent she is about to enter.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, its edges darkened; she stands tall and calm with a small coal-box at her hip, on the night she knew the island coal was dying. Face: most important, the singed brows: straight brows shortened and uneven, scorched to almost nothing at the outer ends. A long, strong, bony face of about forty-eight with high cheekbones, steady dark eyes, a firm mouth with a faint smile of resolve, lines of weather at the eyes. Hair: black with grey threads, pulled tight into a high knot with a short singed fringe over the forehead, the singed ends curling where the flame took them, under a plain bronze circlet. Body: tall and straight-backed, broad through the shoulder, long strong hands, the frame of a woman who carried coal. Clothing: the founder's dress in an old, grand style: a long robe of rust and crimson silk with a high crossed collar lined in grey seal fur, a darker ember-red gauze over-robe, a sleeveless coat of thick dark seal-skin over it, collars embroidered with the first flame and snowflake in gold thread, a wide belt. Hands and objects: a small lidded coal-box of pale green jade hanging by a cord and held against her right hip; her left hand open and relaxed. Power: a strong red-orange heat glows round her hands and the jade box, softened by the fade, and sparks rise from the coal like slow stars. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with a faint rising orange glow low behind her. Light: soft warm light from the upper left, a soot-dark vignette. Expression: unafraid and resolved, the eyes already on the vent.

people.imagined: 884, the whale road. A memorial portrait of the giant at the bow of his hunter's skiff with the white-streaked beard blown across his chest and the scar across his shoulder bare, looking at the sea that took him.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, its edges darkened; a giant stands bare-shouldered at the bow of a hunter's skiff, looking out at the sea that took him. Face: most important, the scar and the beard: a broad rope-like scar runs diagonally across the right bare shoulder and upper chest, pale and raised, clearly visible; a thick black beard streaked in two broad white stripes from the chin to the chest. A huge, square, weathered face of about forty-five with a heavy brow, small fierce dark eyes narrowed at the horizon, a hooked nose, a wide mouth set in arrogant calm, deep seams at the eyes. Hair: black and thick, shoulder-length, blown back by the wind, a braid in front, two grey strands across his brow. Body: a giant, broad chest and thick arms, barrel torso. Clothing: the dress of a hunter-lord of the whale road, in the grand old style: a sleeveless vest of dark sealskin worn open and leaving the right shoulder bare, over a deep sea-blue silk robe trailing from the waist, embroidered at the hem with leaping whales in silver thread, heavy trousers of oiled hide, a belt of braided sea-silk with a bone clasp, a bronze bracer on each forearm. Hands and objects: a long whale-rib harpoon with an iron head lifted over the right shoulder, one fist round the shaft; a coiled line at his feet. Power: a pale blue-green mist of sea qi gathers about the harpoon's head and swirls in the spray, softened by the fade. Background: a faded grey-blue sea and sky as on old silk, a smear of white spray, a headland like a thumbprint of ink. Light: cold sea light from the upper left, yellowed. Expression: a lordly, fearless stillness, the eyes on the sea.

people.imagined: 1098, the last day before seclusion. A memorial portrait of the tiny severe healer, long braid unfinished down her back, in satchel green, her hands folded on a closed satchel as she steps toward the closed door.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, its edges darkened; on the last day before her seclusion a tiny, severe woman stands facing the viewer with her hands folded, about to step toward a closed door. Face: most important, the unfinished braid and the green: a very long single braid of grey-black hair hangs forward over her left shoulder to her waist, the last hand's-breadth unbraided in loose strands; her whole dress is a deep forest green, the one strong colour. A small, narrow, severe face of about fifty-five with high flat cheekbones, thin dark brows drawn together, sharp black eyes, a small thin nose, a thin lipless mouth, fine lines everywhere, pale skin. Hair: grey-black, parted at the side and drawn smoothly back from a high pale brow, held by a small jade pin. Body: tiny, very upright. Clothing: the dress of the last head of a healers' hall, an old house with its own colour: three layers of green silk, a long robe with plain wide sleeves and a high crossed collar, a short sleeveless jade-green gauze jacket over it, collars and cuffs embroidered in pale gold with herb leaves, a narrow dark-green sash, a green cloth-wrapped satchel hanging at her right side. Hands and objects: her small hands folded in front over a closed dark green leather satchel with a brass buckle; her knuckles small and bony with a faint tinge of herb-green in the nails. Power: a faint green breath of wood qi rises from the satchel in slow motes, softened by the fade. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with the faint shapes of hanging herb bundles. Light: soft grey light from the upper left, a dark vignette, the greens turned deep olive on a ground of cream and ash. Expression: a severe, unyielding stillness, the sharp eyes on the closed door.
